changes.title: Repairs from the build 544 browser check: names on phone lists, Updates page loading [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Build 544 passed its browser check and runs on the owner's instance. These repair what that check still found. The look does not change and no control was removed.

- Names on phone lists: Scripts, Automations, Dashboards, Backups, Labels, Helpers, Blueprints, Tags and Users lost most of the name's width to the new action and details columns. The shared column helpers now wrap by default, so a table that uses them cannot forget: the name keeps 150 px of text and the buttons move to their own line. Both row buttons stay one press away on a phone. - Updates page: after a run that updated the Supervisor and Core together, the reloaded page could sit on a spinner. Its loads only started if the backup and Supervisor parts were already there, and after such a reload they arrive later. The loads now start whenever those parts appear, with a time limit and retries, and after 30 seconds a plain line with a Reload button says what is still missing. A run that went back to an older build no longer shows as running. - Detail rows: Escape closes the row from its own toggle too, and focus returns to the toggle. - Details: a long label goes above its value and no longer runs into it. - The colour
changes.detail_yue: 544 版瀏覽器檢查之後嘅修正：手機清單嘅名同更新頁載入。 544 版過咗檢查，而家喺屋主部機行緊。樣冇變，冇減任何掣。 手機清單：腳本、自動化、儀表板、備份、標籤、輔助工具等，個名俾 新加嘅掣迫到好窄。共用欄位而家預設識轉行：個名最少有 150 像素， 啲掣自己落一行，兩個掣喺手機都係一撳就到。 更新頁：Supervisor 同 Core 一齊更新之後，頁面重新載入可能係咁轉圈。 而家啲資料幾時到就幾時開始載入，有時限同重試，三十秒仲未齊就 出一句說明同重新載入掣。返去舊版之後唔會再顯示「行緊」。 詳細資料行撳 Escape 會收埋兼焦點返去個掣；標籤長就擺上面； 揀色板有返邊距；二十四小時制時間全部兩位數。 仲未喺瀏覽器睇過。
